candidates.explanation: The ternary is inverted. When uniformErrors is false, it returns the generic incorrectEmailOrPassword. When uniformErrors is true, it returns the specific per-field errors (notFound / incorrectPassword). That leaks which emails are registered, and it is the opposite of what the flag is meant to do.

fix.description: Flip the condition so the generic error is returned when uniformErrors is true and the specific errors are returned otherwise.
